\begin{lemma}
The score vector is the gradient of the log discriminant.
\end{lemma}
\begin{proof}
Differentiate the discriminant directly.
\end{proof}

\begin{lemma}
Reciprocal Fisher information is concave along the heat flow.
\end{lemma}
\begin{proof}
By Lemma 1, the score is a gradient, so the flow is a gradient flow.
\end{proof}

\begin{proposition}
Finite free convolution satisfies a Stam inequality.
\end{proposition}
\begin{proof}
Using Lemma 2 and integrating along the flow gives the inequality.
\end{proof}
